records.jp: あら、白井さん。<CR>いいところに来てくれたわ
records.en_original: Oh, Shirai. You came at the perfect time.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Shirai. You came at the perfect time.
records.en: Oh, Shirai-san.<CR>You came at the perfect time.

records.jp: 史緒？　<CR>いいところって……何かあったの？
records.en_original: Fumio? What do you mean by that? Did something happen?
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio? What do you mean by that? Did something happen?
records.en: Fumio?<CR>What do you mean? Did something happen?

records.jp: ううん、何かあったってわけじゃないんだけど……
records.en_original: No, not exactly...
records.en_auxiliary: No, not exactly...
records.en: No, not exactly...

records.jp: この前、白井さんに付き合ってもらって<CR>発表会の練習をしたでしょう？
records.en_original: Remember the other day, when I had you join me as I practiced my recital?
records.en_auxiliary: Remember the other day, when I had you join me as I practiced my recital?
records.en: Remember the other day, Shirai-san,<CR>when I had you listen as I practiced for the recital?

records.jp: おかげで発表会ではそこそこいい演奏ができたんだけど、<CR>それでもまだ理想の音色には辿り着けていないの
records.en_original: Well, it mostly paid off. I had a pretty good performance at the recital, although it's still not ideal.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it mostly paid off. I had a pretty good performance at the recital, although I still have things to work on.
records.en: Thanks to you, I gave a fairly good performance at the recital,<CR>but I still haven't reached my ideal tone.

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: I-I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I see.
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: 時にハッと息をのみ、またある時には喜びに胸が躍り、<CR>音があらゆるもの全てを包み込む……
records.en_original: Sometimes the listeners just gasp, other times their hearts dance with joy. Sound envelops anything and everything...
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes the listeners just gasp, and other times their hearts dance with joy. Sound envelops anything and everything.
records.en: At times, it makes listeners gasp; at others, their hearts leap with joy,<CR>and the sound envelops everything...

records.jp: 聴いた人が身も心も震わせずにはいられないような、<CR>最高の……ううん、そんなありきたりな言葉じゃダメ
records.en_original: But I want to be so great, the listeners tremble down to their souls... No, such words fall short of my vision.
records.en_auxiliary: But I want to be so great, the listeners tremble down to their souls. I want them to tremble more than words can describe.
records.en: The kind of sound that makes listeners tremble in body and soul...<CR>The greatest—no, such a commonplace word won't do.

records.jp: いわば天使の奏でる旋律……いいえ、いっそ神様の声そのものと<CR>言ってもいいわね。それを、ピアノで表現するのよ
records.en_original: A tune played by angels...! Nay, what could be called the voice of God! That's what I want to express with the piano!
records.en_auxiliary: A tune played by angels! Nay, what could be called the voice of God! That's what I want to express with the piano!
records.en: A melody played by angels... No, you could even call it<CR>the very voice of God. That's what I'll express on the piano.

records.jp: よ、よくわからないけど、すごい音なんだってことは<CR>わかったよ……
records.en_original: I-I don't exactly get it, but I think you're trying to tell me you want to play something amazing...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I don't exactly get it, but I think you're trying to tell me you want to play something amazing.
records.en: I-I don't really understand, but I get that<CR>you want to create an incredible sound...

records.jp: （史緒、すごい向上心だなあ……。<CR>……練習に付き合うのは大変だったけど）
records.en_original: (Fumio seems really ambitious... Although helping her practice is pretty rough.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Fumio seems really ambitious. Although helping her practice is pretty tough.)
records.en: (Fumio is so driven to improve...<CR>Though helping her practice was exhausting.)

records.jp: でも、聴いている人がどう感じるか……<CR>一人で考えて弾いても、なかなか音が変わらないのよね
records.en_original: But playing on my own doesn't help me understand how my listeners feel, so my approach doesn't change much.
records.en_auxiliary: But playing on my own doesn't help me understand how my listeners feel, so my approach doesn't change much.
records.en: But even when I play while thinking about how the audience will feel,<CR>my sound doesn't change much.

records.jp: ここはやっぱり白井さんにもう一度聴いてもらって……<CR>でも、白井さんにも都合とかあるだろうし……
records.en_original: I'd like you to listen again...though I'm sure you have your own things to do...
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like you to listen again... though I'm sure you have your own things to do.
records.en: I suppose I should have Shirai-san listen again...<CR>But she must have her own plans...

records.jp: ……うん、そうよね。気づかいは大事！<CR>何か他の方法を考えなくっちゃ
records.en_original: ...She must. I need to try to be more understanding of other people. There must be another way to improve...
records.en_auxiliary: ...She must. I need to try to be more understanding of other people. There must be another way to improve.
records.en: ...Right. Consideration is important!<CR>I need to think of another way.

records.jp: あ、相変わらず口に出てる……
records.en_original: Y-You're thinking out loud again...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you're thinking out loud again.
records.en: Y-You're thinking out loud again...

records.jp: 他の方法といっても……うーん、<CR>一旦ピアノから離れてみないとダメかな
records.en_original: But what could it be? Hmm, maybe I'll have to get away from the piano for a while.
records.en_auxiliary: But what could it be? Hmm, maybe I'll have to get away from the piano for a while.
records.en: Another way... Hmm.<CR>Maybe I need to step away from the piano for a while.

records.jp: 演奏することばかり考えていても、<CR>視野が狭くなってしまいそうだし……
records.en_original: If I just keep thinking about my performance, I feel like my vision will narrow too much...
records.en_auxiliary: If I just keep thinking about my performance, I feel like my vision will narrow too much.
records.en: If all I think about is performing,<CR>my perspective might become too narrow...

records.jp: あの……史緒……？
records.en_original: Um... Fumio...?
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Fumio?
records.en: Um... Fumio...?

records.jp: ピアノ以外のことに目を向けるのも必要かしら。<CR>見識を広めるって大事なことだもの
records.en_original: Maybe I should look at things other than the piano. It's important to expand your horizons, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe I should look at things other than the piano. It's important to expand your horizons, after all.
records.en: Perhaps I need to turn my attention to things besides the piano.<CR>It's important to broaden one's horizons.

records.jp: ああでも、見識を広めないとなんて自分から言ったら、<CR>世間知らずの自覚があるのに何もしない人って思われそう……
records.en_original: But if I say that I NEED to expand my horizons, others might think willfully ignorant of the world around me...
records.en_auxiliary: But if I say that I NEED to expand my horizons, others might think I'm willfully ignorant of the world around me.
records.en: But if I say I need to broaden my horizons myself,<CR>people might think I know I'm sheltered and still do nothing about it...

records.jp: たぶん、すでに色々やってるとは思うけど<CR>見識を広めるのはどうかな……
records.en_original: I'm sure you already do all sorts of different things, but I think you should try expanding your horizons...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure you already do all sorts of different things, but I think you should try expanding your horizons.
records.en: I'm sure you've already tried many things,<CR>but how about broadening your horizons?

records.jp: 今まで行ったことのないところに行くと<CR>何か発見があるかもしれないしさ
records.en_original: If you go places you've never been before, you might gain a new perspective on things.
records.en_auxiliary: If you go places you've never been before, you might gain a new perspective on things.
records.en: Going somewhere you've never been before<CR>might lead to some new discovery.

records.jp: そ、そうね、それはいいかも！
records.en_original: Y-You're right! That would be a good idea!
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you're right! That would be a good approach!
records.en: Y-You're right! That would be a good idea!

records.jp: 例えばだけど……お店で流れてる音楽とか、<CR>来たお客さんに向けて流しているものだよね
records.en_original: For example... Stores play music for their customers, right?
records.en_auxiliary: For example, stores play music for their customers, right?
records.en: For example... The music playing in a shop<CR>is meant for the customers who come in, right?

records.jp: お客さんにどんな気持ちになってほしいか、<CR>考えながら流してるものなんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: So do you they're actually thinking about the feelings of the customers when they choose their music?
records.en_auxiliary: So do you think they're actually considering the feelings of the customers when they choose their music?
records.en: So perhaps they choose it while thinking about<CR>how they want those customers to feel?

records.jp: なるほど……参考になったわ、白井さん
records.en_original: Interesting... That's a good thought, Shirai.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. That's a good thought, Shirai.
records.en: I see... That's helpful, Shirai-san.

records.jp: たまには音を聴く側になってみるのも必要ね。<CR>さっそく出かける準備をしなくちゃ！
records.en_original: It's important to be a listener sometimes. I need to get ready to go exploring!
records.en_auxiliary: It's important to be a listener sometimes. I need to get ready to go exploring!
records.en: Sometimes I need to be on the listening side too.<CR>I should get ready to go out right away!

records.jp: うん。役に立って良かったよ
records.en_original: Alright. I'm glad I could help.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. I'm glad I could help.
records.en: All right. I'm glad I could help.

records.jp: ありがとう、白井さん！<CR>それじゃあまた！
records.en_original: Thank you, Shirai! See you again!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Shirai! See you later!
records.en: Thank you, Shirai-san!<CR>See you later!

records.jp: ぼーっとしてみる……のはどうかな。<CR>自然と色んな音が耳に入ってくるし、何か得られるかも
records.en_original: How about...clearing your mind? Just let all kinds of sounds flow into your ears. You might learn something.
records.en_auxiliary: How about... clearing your mind? Just let all kinds of sounds flow into your ears. You might discover something.
records.en: How about... letting your mind go blank?<CR>You would naturally hear all kinds of sounds, and might discover something.

records.jp: む、私とは違う考えだわ……
records.en_original: Hm. That's not exactly what I was thinking...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. That's not exactly what I was thinking.
records.en: Hm. That's not exactly what I was thinking...

records.jp: （うん、知ってる……）
records.en_original: (Yeah, I know...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Yeah, I know.)
records.en: (Yeah, I know...)

records.jp: でも、そういうのもありかもしれないわね。<CR>色んな音に耳を澄ませるのは新たな発見に繋がるもの
records.en_original: But that might be good, too. Hearing sounds I take for granted could help inspire me.
records.en_auxiliary: But that might be good, too. Hearing sounds I take for granted could help inspire me.
records.en: But that might work too.<CR>Listening closely to all kinds of sounds could lead to new discoveries.

records.jp: うん。それに、町のあちこちで流れている音楽も、<CR>聴いた人がどんな気分になるか考えられてると思うよ
records.en_original: Yeah. Also, you can listen to music playing around town, and think about how the people listening to it feel.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Also, you can listen to music playing around town and think about how the people listening to it feel.
records.en: Yeah. And I think the music playing around town is chosen<CR>with how it will make listeners feel in mind.

records.jp: なるほど……音楽を聴いたらどんな気分になるか、<CR>自分の耳で確かめるのね
records.en_original: Interesting... To think I can experience the feelings of a listener with my own two ears.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting. To think I can experience the feelings of a listener with my own two ears.
records.en: I see... So I'll use my own ears<CR>to find out how music makes me feel.

records.jp: 確かに、これまで演奏の仕方とか技術的なことしか<CR>気にしたことなかったかも
records.en_original: Before now, I've only ever cared about the performance of music, not listening to it!
records.en_auxiliary: Before now, I've only ever cared about the performance of music, not listening to it!
records.en: Now that I think about it, I may have only ever focused<CR>on how to perform and other technical matters.

records.jp: ありがとう、白井さん。<CR>今度そういう聴き方もしてみるわ
records.en_original: Thank you, Shirai. I'll try listening like that sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Shirai. I'll try opening my ears more.
records.en: Thank you, Shirai-san.<CR>I'll try listening that way sometime.

records.jp: うん、新しい発見があるといいね
records.en_original: Sure. I hope it leads to some new discoveries!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. I hope it leads to some new discoveries!
records.en: Sure. I hope it leads to some new discoveries!
